title: Horton 2025-10 Designed Kingdom 1: Dominate, Swap, Falconer, Taskmaster

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: October 2025 Tournament Summary; Designed Kingdom 1, designed and playtested by Horton

quality_note: Designer explains the competing build paths and key tricks, but intends a tactical board with no single best line.
